Name: nofox SweetDelightFood
Author: nofoxii
Description:
Hello everyone! 🍑
I’ve tried my hand at creating some recipes this time, and I’m excited to share them with you!

I’ve made a bunch of delicious treats, most of which are peach-themed—think soft peach mochi, creamy peach ice cream, fluffy peach Swiss rolls, and more!

There are also a few other sweet surprises like matcha cream ice cake and chocolate-filled bread to satisfy your sweet tooth.

✨ What’s in this mod?

- 17 brand-new cooking recipes (12 peach-focused + 5 classic sweet treats)

- All recipes are purchasable at the Saloon (Gus’s shop) for easy unlocking

- Unique in-game descriptions for each food, with cute details (like the cat-shaped caramel pudding!)

- Balanced in-game stats (price, edibility) that fit perfectly with vanilla Stardew Valley

- Full compatibility with most popular mods

Hope you enjoy these sweet, fruity treats in your farm life!
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to leave a comment below. Thanks for playing! 🥰

Version: 1.0.0
Language: English & Chinese

Downloads.Description: Fixed the bug of incorrect recipe items.
